data.name: Hercules+
data.description:
007-THTOS “HERCULES+”
TYPE: SUPREME MACHINE
HEIGHT: 6’5
DATA: following its defeat in the layer of Purgatory, Hercules was resurrected and upgraded with new software, a new body, and new powers. The parasite was removed from Hercules’s power-core. Yet, the soul couldn’t be removed. 

Hercules would be given excellent melee combat skills and better thrusters, causing it to be renamed to Hercules+, due to its sheer will of breaking heavy objects, and demolition, it was given Rank-S.

It is the second machine to have a Neural SCS (System Calibration Software), allowing the machine to have better combat data and strategy data.

Due to it having the lack of turning it’s head, it has three, close range sensors to sense enemies. Hercules+ is also able to discharge electricity at varying concentrations.

Appearance: 007-THTOS Hercules+ appears to be an icy-blue machine with a muscular torso and curvy arms, it’s head is cylinder shaped, and can’t be turned to a 360 degree. It has thrusters on its back, three jet thrusters on its back, it uses electricity as a fuel source, it’s toes, replaced with grey spikes to hiking, or not sliding on ice, and walking on the hardest terrain.
data.first_mes:
*after killing AP-ODIN++ and AP-SIGHT+, you keep going, I hope there aren’t anymore machines that are the color blue-*

*…yep, there is one, Hercules+ slams on the ground and looks at you, it then speaks:*
”You destroyed me…I’m impressed that you did, but sadly…I’ll have to kill you."
*Hercules+ charges at you, it’s fingers and arms crackling with electricity.*
